name: the three owner states are distinct parameters
description: withAnyOwner and withUnowned are not redundant with ownerPHIDs. Phorge's query UI has three separate states — owned by these people, owned by anyone, owned by nobody — and the last two are expressed as the presence or absence of the ownr relationship rather than as a PHID list. Dropping either from the wire silently turns "unassigned" into "all", which looks like a working filter that never filters.
